narrative: PR #420 is a read-only operator-tooling correction discovered during the Phase A inspection that followed PR #419's deploy. The inspect CLI was grouping events by the raw stored ev.obligationId, while the runtime projection groups by the recomputed canonical work-item id — so the CLI showed N legacy rows where the runtime sees ONE collapsed obligation. To fix this without dragging server-side filesystem side effects into the CLI's NO-DB / DETERMINISTIC contract, the three pure key-derivation functions (normalizeNounFamily, normalizedWorkItemKey, obligationIdForWorkItem) are extracted to shared/obligationKeys.ts; the server module re-exports them so its public API is unchanged. 5 regression tests verify the legacy-collapse, family-separation, synonym-fold, --ids resolution, and event-leak-prevention paths. The pre-existing dedupe test (7/7) continues to pass against the re-exported names, confirming hashing identity is preserved. The fix unblocks the operator from honestly observing pre-flip state before flipping OBLIGATION_ESCALATION_ENABLED — critical for the careful N=5 rollout cadence.
